name: Trieste to the Challenger Deep
summary: Two men sealed inside a steel sphere slung beneath a float of gasoline sink nearly eleven kilometres to the floor of the Mariana Trench, the deepest point of the ocean. No one returns there for 52 years.

stops.note: The bathyscaphe Trieste is towed out by the USS Wandank.
At 08:23 Piccard and Walsh begin to descend.
At 13:06 they touch bottom at about 10,900 metres. An outer window has cracked on the way down. They report seeing a flatfish.
Back on the surface at 16:56, after nine hours.
